physicalChanges.currentObservation: Current table score is rebuilt through the canonical risk snapshot boundary and exact-shape verified before use.
physicalChanges.separateTruths: Current table score and latest stored observation are rendered as separate values with separate timestamps and UI markers.
physicalChanges.timeAlignment: ObservedAt ordering is explicit; a stored history observation newer than current evidence withholds the current value inside Risk History.
physicalChanges.identityAlignment: Canonical asset identity mismatch fails closed and prevents either value being presented as aligned.
physicalChanges.versionAlignment: Methodology, score, evidence and comparability versions are compared before same-segment claims.
physicalChanges.sameTimeConflict: Same-timestamp score or version conflict withholds current display rather than choosing one silently.
physicalChanges.historyPreservation: A withheld current observation does not erase independently publishable stored history.
physicalChanges.precisionDisclosure: Current table precision and integer stored-history normalization are disclosed separately.

truthBoundary: Local runtime/static/source/UI-boundary proof only. No rendered Browser, deployed HTTP, database, real customer input or Risk Indicator FINAL credit.
